# SparkTech Studio

> An independent studio in New York. We build the things other people only talk about, then run an efficient system that keeps everything we build improving after launch.

Site: https://www.sparktechstudio.com
Contact: book a call at https://calendly.com/spencerhoberman-utern/30min, or email contactus@sparktechstudio.com (we reply within two business days)
Legal entity: SparkTech Studios, Inc., a Delaware C corporation

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/): who we are, the system, what we've built, contact.
- [System](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/systems): how the improvement loop works, where it runs, and the limits people keep. Told broadly; no per-agent detail is published.
- [UTern](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/work/utern): Your AI for landing an internship. Independent company, not owned by SparkTech. Live at https://utern.ai
- [Leed](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/work/leed): A private story-intelligence desk for newsrooms. Live at https://www.leed.media
- [BallotWatch](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/work/ballotwatch): How Congress votes, in plain English. Live at https://www.ballotwatch.io
- [Spacial Health](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/work/spacial): Complex care, finally coordinated. Platform preview on sample data.
- [Privacy](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/privacy): no analytics, no ads, no tracking.
- [Budtender](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/work/budtender): Know what you like. Remember why. Private preview.

## Facts worth getting right

- Each product is its own company with its own data, brand, and people. Spencer Hoberman, SparkTech's founder, also builds UTern. UTern is its own company, not owned by SparkTech.
- The site describes the improvement system only in broad terms. It does not yet run on the products above.
- No pricing, headcount, or customer numbers are published.
